 LE SSERAFIM Asia Tour — K-Pop Group Kicks Off PUREFLOW in Macau
 Nov 5, 2026 4:10 PM PST [Photo] OSEN DB. 
 LE SSERAFIM Asia Tour officially kicks off its spectacular journey this weekend as the popular K-pop group embarks on their highly anticipated series of concerts.
 LE SSERAFIM will host the ‘2026 LE SSERAFIM TOUR ‘PUREFLOW’ IN ASIA’, starting with performances at the Macau Galaxy Arena on November 7-8, followed by stops in Taipei on November 14-15, Singapore on November 28, and Manila on December 5. Notably, ticket sales for the second show in Taipei sold out early on, proving their immense local popularity and strong ticket-selling power.
 Through their agency Source Music, LE SSERAFIM shared their excitement, stating, “We are thrilled to meet FEARNOTs across Asia for our third tour already. We are so excited to spend an enjoyable time together with new songs and diverse performances. We will do our absolute best to show a more mature side of ourselves than ever before.”
 Scale and Highlights of the PUREFLOW Tour
 Spanning a total of six shows across four cities, this marks the group’s third Asian tour since their debut solo tour in 2023. Macau has been newly added as a tour stop this year, with performances set in massive venues such as the Macau Galaxy Arena and the approximately 15,000-seat Taipei NTSU Arena. The concerts promise an overwhelming scale fitting large venues, featuring lifts to connect closely with the audience and an actual parade car from their 2nd full-length album title track ‘BOOMPALA’ music video brought onto the stage to elevate the festival atmosphere.
 Continued Global Momentum
 Building on last year’s tour, where they received rave reviews from local media for their solid live vocals and performances alongside enthusiastic support from top Asian stars like Jolin Tsai, Greg Hsu, and JJ Lin, expectations are running high for the dazzling performances LE SSERAFIM will deliver in this upcoming run.
